source_title: Ishan Kishan ruled out of third T20I against New Zealand; Kumar Kushagra stays with India - Sportstar
source_excerpt: Ishan Kishan ruled out of third India vs New Zealand T20I in Wellington left Ishan Kishan’s recovery from injury is going well. ANI ANI https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/wmr0n6/article71625594.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/20261017409L.jpg ANI Bengaluru, Oct 17 (ANI): India's Ishan Kishan plays a shot during the 5th T20I against West Indies at M.Chinnaswamy Stadium, in Bengaluru on Saturday. (ANI Photo) Ishan Kishan has been ruled out of India’s third T20I against New Zealand in Wellington as he continues to recover from a right adductor strain. Ishan Kishan is recovering well from the low-grade right adductor strain he sustained during the first T20I against New Zealand. However, he is yet to regain match fitness and has been ruled out of the third T20I, scheduled for October 27, 2026, in Wellington. The BCCI medical team continues to monitor his recovery. Kumar Kushagra will remain with the Indian squad for the third T20I. Kishan’s injury prompted India to rejig its batting order in the series opener, promoting Tilak Varma to No. 3, Kishan’s usual position. Kishan batted at No. 5 and managed just one run off three balls before being caught on the leg-side boundary off Mitchell Santner. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, who had been on the bench for India’s previous four T20Is after featuring in the semifinal and final of its victorious Asian Games campaign, replaced Kishan in the XI for the second T20I and is likely to retain his place for the third match.

## चोट पर अपडेट
ईशान किशन को न्यूजीलैंड के खिलाफ वेलिंगटन में 27 अक्टूबर, 2026 को होने वाले तीसरे T20I मैच से बाहर कर दिया गया है। विकेटकीपर-बल्लेबाज वर्तमान में दाहिनी एडक्टर मांसपेशियों में खिंचाव (लो-ग्रेड राइट एडक्टर स्ट्रेन) से उबर रहे हैं, जो उन्हें श्रृंखला के पहले मैच के दौरान लगी थी।

## टीम की स्थिति
बीसीसीआई की मेडिकल टीम ईशान किशन की रिकवरी पर लगातार नजर बनाए हुए है। हालांकि उनकी रिकवरी अच्छी चल रही है, लेकिन वे अभी तक अंतरराष्ट्रीय मैच के लिए पूरी तरह फिट नहीं हो पाए हैं। इसके परिणामस्वरूप, कुमार कुशाग्र आगामी मैच के लिए भारतीय टीम के साथ बने रहेंगे।

## टीम पर प्रभाव
पहले T20I में ईशान किशन के चोटिल होने के बाद, भारतीय टीम ने अपनी संरचना में बदलाव किए हैं:
* दूसरे मैच में तिलक वर्मा को बल्लेबाजी क्रम में तीसरे नंबर पर प्रमोट किया गया था।
* वैभव सूर्यवंशी, जो शुरुआती मैचों में प्लेइंग इलेवन का हिस्सा नहीं थे, ने दूसरे T20I में किशन की जगह ली।
* उम्मीद है कि वेलिंगटन में होने वाले तीसरे T20I के लिए वैभव सूर्यवंशी अपनी जगह बरकरार रखेंगे।

प्रशंसकों को सलाह दी जाती है कि वे टीम चयन और चोट से उबरने की प्रक्रिया के बारे में आधिकारिक बीसीसीआई घोषणाओं और सोशल मीडिया चैनलों का अनुसरण करें।

en_body:
## Injury Update
Ishan Kishan has been ruled out of India’s third T20I against New Zealand, set to be held in Wellington on October 27, 2026. The wicketkeeper-batter is currently recovering from a low-grade right adductor strain, an injury sustained during the opening match of the series.

## Squad Status
The BCCI medical team is continuing to monitor Kishan's progress. While his recovery is reported to be on track, he has not yet regained full match fitness required for international competition. Consequently, Kumar Kushagra will continue to stay with the Indian squad for the upcoming encounter.

## Team Impact
Following Kishan's injury in the first T20I, India has adjusted its team composition:
* Tilak Varma was promoted to the No. 3 batting position in the second match.
* Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, who did not feature in the initial games, replaced Kishan in the playing XI for the second T20I.
* Sooryavanshi is expected to retain his spot in the team for the third T20I in Wellington.

Fans are advised to follow official BCCI communications and social media channels for further updates regarding team selections and injury rehabilitation progress.
